faq_items.question: Is the beta free?
faq_items.answer: Applying is free. Once you're in, you use the real platform on a real plan, with real pricing, exactly like a regular client.

faq_items.question: How much does the platform cost during the beta?
faq_items.answer: Three plans. Pay as you go: 3% fee on each top-up, no subscription. Mixed: $60 a month plus 2% per top-up. No commission: $100 a month, no top-up fees. On every plan: $10 minimum deposit and top-up, and $8 per ad account request.

faq_items.question: How are testers selected?
faq_items.answer: Spots are limited to 35. We review every early access request and pick a mix of agencies, affiliate buyers, e-commerce brands and solo advertisers. Shortlisted applicants get a short call. Everyone else goes on our waiting list.

faq_items.question: How much time will it take?
faq_items.answer: About 3 hours in total, over [3 weeks]: a 45-minute kickoff session (recorded), five short test tasks (about 2 hours), and a 15-minute final survey.

faq_items.question: What will I actually test?
faq_items.answer: Five tasks: set up your workspace, link or find your Meta ad account, invite a teammate and set their role, allocate and release funds, and choose the plan that fits your spend.

faq_items.question: Do I need to deposit real money?
faq_items.answer: Not to apply. To run live campaigns through V2, you fund your balance as usual, from $10. We'll never push you to deposit more than your ads need.

faq_items.question: What if I don't have a Meta Business Manager?
faq_items.answer: You can still join. We'll give you a demo account for the account-linking task.

faq_items.question: Which platforms and payment methods are included?
faq_items.answer: Meta only during the beta. You can fund your balance in USDT through Binance or an external wallet, or by card where available.

faq_items.question: Which plan will I be on?
faq_items.answer: We spread plans across testers so every model gets tested. You'll see your plan and its pricing in your confirmation email, with the dates and the tester charter, before you commit.

faq_items.question: How do I get help during the test?
faq_items.answer: You'll join a small group of six, matched to your time zone. Our team runs two live office hours a week and answers every question within one business day.

faq_items.question: What exactly is the free month?
faq_items.answer: One month without Adxens top-up or subscription fees, starting at the public launch. Payment provider fees and ad account opening fees ($8 per request) aren't included.

faq_items.question: Does Adxens guarantee ad approval?
faq_items.answer: No. Meta reviews every ad. We give you agency accounts and a faster workflow, not exemptions.

faq_items.question: Is there a referral or affiliate program?
faq_items.answer: Not in this beta. Your spot and your reward never depend on inviting anyone.

faq_items.question: Can I leave the beta?
faq_items.answer: Yes, anytime, with no consequences. Just let us know so we can offer your spot to someone on the waiting list.

faq_items.question: What happens after the beta?
faq_items.answer: Your account and setup carry over to the public launch.

All advertising accounts provided by Adxens Group are identified and tracked by two primary data points: (1) the Account Name assigned within the platform, and (2) the Unique Ad Account ID generated by the host network (e.g., Meta, TikTok, Google, Snapchat).

“Advertising Spend” is defined strictly as the monetary value of media inventory consumed by the Ad Account, as reported by the respective third-party advertising network. The user acknowledges that the third-party network’s reporting serves as the sole and final source of truth for calculating Advertising Spend. Default commission rates may apply and are subject to adjustment depending on the platform, account type, volume, and any specific arrangements agreed between Adxens Group and the client. Adxens Group reserves the right to modify commission fees at any time, with the assurance that any changes will be communicated to the client in advance and will not apply retrospectively to top-ups processed prior to the change. The applicable commission rate for each account will be visible to the client through the Adxens platform.
Wallet Balances

Funds deposited into your Adxens Wallet or allocated to an advertising account are available for media buying immediately. Requests to withdraw unspent funds must be processed in accordance with the Refund Policy outlined in Section 12. Adxens Group reserves the right not to offer any type of credit to the user.

It is the user’s sole responsibility to monitor and verify the accuracy of their Adxens Wallet balance, advertising account balances, and all transaction records displayed on the platform. The user must review their balance promptly after each deposit, top-up, or transaction to ensure it has been correctly credited. Each plan falls into one of the following categories, as displayed on the Adxens platform at the time of selection:
(a) Fixed-fee plans: the user pays a recurring subscription fee and no commission on Ad Account Top-Ups.
(b) Commission-only plans: the user pays no subscription fee but pays a commission on each Ad Account Top-Up.
(c) Hybrid plans: the user pays both a recurring subscription fee and a reduced commission on each Ad Account Top-Up.

By selecting a plan, the user agrees to pay the subscription fee (if any) and the Commissions (if any) that apply to that plan at the time of selection. 7. Tax Cashback and Recovery
7.1 Scope
This Section applies exclusively to Meta and Google advertising accounts (Taxed Ad Platforms). It does not presently apply to TikTok and other advertising accounts.
7.2 Digital Services Taxes

Digital Services Taxes based on the countries and regions targeted by Ad campaigns through this Taxed Ad Platforms will be requested by each Ad Platform during the billing period. These taxes are invoiced by each plateform during its billing period. The tax rate vary by country, with rates that may reach up to 7% of ad spend or more, and may change at any time without notice from the Platform.

Because Digital Services Taxes are only known after the end of the billing period, the Platform applies a Provisional Taxes of 4% on each top-up of a Taxed Ad Platform (the "Provisional Taxes"). The Provisional Taxes is an advance estimate collected on the client’s behalf to cover Digital Services Taxes on spends made through Taxed Ad Plateforms. It is not a service fee or a revenue of the Platform.
7.3 Period-End Reconciliation

After receiving invoices for each billing period and from each Taxed Ad Plateforms, Adxens will compare the total Provisional Taxes collected for each Taxed Ad Plateforms with the digital service taxes actually invoiced within the unréconciled period (the "Reconciliation").

If the Provisional Taxes collected per Taxed Ad Platforms exceeds the Digital Services Taxes actually invoiced, Adxens will credit the difference to the client’s Wallet as a Tax cashback ("Tax Cashback"). The Tax Cashback is a refund of an overpayment and has no value other than as a Wallet balance adjustment.

If the Provisional Taxes collected is lower than the Digital Services Taxes actually invoiced, the Platform may debit the difference (the "Taxes Owed") from the balance otl. The client expressly authorize the Platform to make this debit automatically, without further approval for each occurrence. The Taxes Owed will never exceed the amount actually invoiced by Google for the relevant account and period.

For each Reconciliation, the Platform will make available in the client dashboard, or notify by email, a statement showing the digital service taxes invoiced and the resulting Tax Cashback or Additional taxes.
If you believe a Reconciliation is incorrect, you may contact support within [30] days of the statement. The Platform will provide a copy of the relevant Google invoice extract on request.
7.4 Insufficient Balance

If the Organisation Balance of the client is insufficient to cover an Taxes Owed related to digital service taxes, the client agrees to regulate the pending and unpaid invoiced taxes, 7 days after notification

The Platform may suspend the clients ability to top up or launch campaigns on Taxed Ad Platforms until the amount is settled, and may request payment by any other means available on the Platform. These remedies are without prejudice to any other rights of the Platform.
7.5 Changes and Corrections

If an Ad Platform issues a corrected or additional invoice for a past period, the Platform may carry out a new Reconciliation for that period, including after the termination of the client account, and the same rules will apply.
7.6 Account Closure
On termination of a client account, any final Cashback will be credited to your remaining balance, and any final Taxes Owed will be payable immediately.

Thank you for Choosing Adxens Group. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, process, store, share, and protect information when you use our platform and services. By accessing or using our services, you agree to the collection and use of your information in accordance with this Privacy Policy and our Terms and Conditions.

Your personal data may be processed by any of these entities depending on the services you utilise and the jurisdiction in which you operate. Adxens Group acts as the data controller in respect of the personal data collected through the platform.

This Privacy Policy has been drafted to comply with applicable data protection laws and regulations, including the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (“GDPR”), the UK General Data Protection Regulation (“UK GDPR”), the Hong Kong Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (Cap. 486) (“PDPO”), and other applicable national and international data protection laws.
Your continued use of our services after any changes to this Privacy Policy indicates your acceptance of those changes. We encourage you to review this policy periodically for updates.
1. Data Controller and Contact
The data controller responsible for your personal data is Adxens Group, customer-service@adxens.com.
For any data protection enquiries, requests to exercise your rights, or complaints, please contact us at the email address above or at the addresses listed in Section 14 of this Privacy Policy.
2. Information We Collect
2.1 Information You Provide
You provide information when you register on our platform, use our services, top up advertising accounts, communicate with us, or submit verification documentation. This may include:
Full name, email address, phone number, and postal address.
Company name, registered address, company registration number, and jurisdiction of incorporation.
Names, identification documents, and details of directors, beneficial owners, or authorised representatives (where requested for verification or compliance purposes).
Proof of source of funds or other documentation requested in connection with our compliance obligations.
Advertising content, URLs, campaign data, and ad account preferences.
Communications with our support team, account managers, or through the platform.
Any additional information you provide to us directly or indirectly through the platform.
2.2 Information Collected Automatically
When you access the platform, we automatically collect:
IP address, browser type and version, device characteristics, and operating system.
Referring URLs, pages visited, and usage patterns on the platform.
Device identifiers (including mobile device ID, model, and manufacturer).
Access times, session duration, and interaction data.
2.3 Payment and Financial Information

Payment information (such as credit/debit card details) is processed by our third-party payment processors, including Stripe, and is not stored on Adxens Group’s servers. Payment processors store and process your data securely and solely for the purpose of processing transactions. See Stripe’s privacy policy at https://stripe.com/gb/privacy.
2.4 Cryptocurrency and Blockchain Data
Where you make payments using cryptocurrency (including USDT, USDC, or other supported digital assets), we collect and process the following additional data:
Cryptocurrency wallet addresses used to send funds to Adxens Group.
Blockchain transaction hashes, amounts, timestamps, and network identifiers.
Risk scores, screening results, and analytics data generated by blockchain analytics and Know Your Transaction (KYT) tools, including but not limited to Elliptic, Chainalysis, and Phalcon.
Records of any sanctions screening, transaction monitoring alerts, or compliance flags associated with your wallet address or transactions.

You acknowledge that blockchain transactions are recorded on public, immutable ledgers and that wallet addresses and transaction data are inherently transparent. Adxens Group processes this data for the purposes of compliance, fraud prevention, and the legitimate interests described in Section 4. You further acknowledge that data recorded on a public blockchain (including transaction hashes, wallet addresses, and transfer amounts) cannot be modified, deleted, or erased by Adxens Group or any other party. Where you exercise your right to erasure under applicable data protection law, Adxens Group will delete or anonymise the internal records linking your identity to blockchain data, but cannot delete the on-chain data itself. This limitation is inherent to blockchain technology and does not constitute non-compliance with any data deletion request.
2.5 Compliance and Verification Data
In connection with our Know Your Business (KYB), anti-money laundering (AML), sanctions screening, and other compliance obligations, we may collect and process:
Company registration documents and certificates.
Identity documents of directors, beneficial owners, or authorised signatories.
Sanctions screening results and watchlist data.
Politically Exposed Person (PEP) screening results.
Adverse media screening results.
Records of compliance decisions, risk assessments, and due diligence outcomes.
2.6 Information Received from Third Parties
Adxens Group may receive personal data about you from third-party sources, which may be combined with information we already hold about you. These sources include:

Blockchain analytics providers (such as Elliptic, Chainalysis, and Phalcon), which may provide risk scores, entity attributions, and compliance flags associated with your wallet addresses or transactions.
Sanctions lists and watchlist databases maintained by governmental authorities (including OFAC, OFSI, the EU, and the United Nations).
Publicly available blockchain data, including transaction histories and wallet activity recorded on public distributed ledgers.
KYB and identity verification providers, company registries, and adverse media databases.
Law enforcement agencies, regulatory authorities, or other financial institutions, in the context of compliance enquiries or investigations.

This data may be used to verify your identity, assess the risk profile of your account or transactions, comply with our legal obligations, and protect Adxens Group and its users from fraud and financial crime.
2.7 Cookies and Tracking Technologies
We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect information about your use of the platform. This includes:
Essential cookies — required for the functioning of the platform, including authentication and session management.
You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of the platform.
3. Lawful Bases for Processing
We process your personal data on the following lawful bases under applicable data protection law:
3.1 Contractual Necessity

Processing necessary for the performance of our contract with you, including: providing the platform and services, managing your account, processing payments and top-ups, providing advertising accounts, and communicating with you about your account and services.
3.2 Legal Obligation

Processing necessary to comply with our legal obligations, including: anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing requirements, sanctions screening and compliance, tax reporting obligations, responding to lawful requests from law enforcement or regulatory authorities, and retaining records as required by applicable law.
3.3 Legitimate Interests

Processing necessary for our legitimate interests or those of a third party, where not overridden by your rights, including: fraud prevention and detection, platform security and integrity, transaction monitoring and risk assessment, blockchain analytics and wallet screening, improving our platform and services, and enforcing our Terms and Conditions.
3.4 Consent

Where we rely on your consent for specific processing activities (such as marketing communications), you have the right to withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us or using the unsubscribe option provided. Withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal.
4. How We Use Your Information
We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
Providing and maintaining the platform and services, including account registration, advertising account provisioning, and payment processing.
Processing transactions, including cryptocurrency payments and fiat payments.
Conducting KYB verification, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, and other compliance activities.
Screening cryptocurrency wallet addresses and transactions using blockchain analytics tools for compliance and fraud prevention purposes.
Detecting, preventing, and investigating fraud, financial crime, and unauthorised or illegal activity.
Responding to your enquiries and providing customer support.
Sending transactional communications, including confirmations, invoices, security alerts, and service updates.
Improving the platform, our services, and the user experience.
Marketing and promotional communications (with your consent, where required).
Complying with applicable laws, regulations, legal processes, and enforceable governmental requests.
Exercising or defending our legal rights.
5. How We Share Your Information
We do not sell your personal data. We share your information only as described below:
5.1 Third-Party Service Providers
We engage third-party service providers to perform functions on our behalf, including:
Payment processing (Stripe and other payment processors).
Cryptocurrency wallet and payment infrastructure providers (Binance Pay).
KYB, AML, and sanctions screening providers.
Cloud hosting and data storage (OVHCloud).
Customer support and communication tools (Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram).
These providers process data solely on our behalf and in accordance with our instructions, subject to appropriate data processing agreements.
5.2 Law Enforcement, Regulators, and Legal Process

We may disclose your personal data, including account information, transaction records, wallet addresses, blockchain analytics data, and compliance documentation, to law enforcement agencies, regulatory authorities, governmental bodies, stablecoin issuers, or courts where:
Required by applicable law, regulation, or legal process.
Necessary to comply with a lawful request from a competent authority.
Necessary to protect the rights, property, or safety of Adxens Group, its users, or others.
Necessary for the detection, prevention, or investigation of fraud, financial crime, or sanctions violations.
Such disclosures may be made without your prior knowledge or consent where permitted or required by law.
5.3 Compliance Information Sharing

Adxens Group may share your personal data, including transaction records, wallet addresses, and compliance documentation, with other financial institutions, cryptocurrency exchanges, payment processors, or counterparties where such sharing is necessary for the purposes of: (a) responding to compliance enquiries or information requests from regulated entities regarding the legitimacy or source of transactions; (b) fulfilling obligations under applicable anti-money laundering, counter-terrorist financing, or sanctions regulations; (c) cooperating with industry-wide fraud prevention or financial crime detection initiatives; or (d) verifying the source or destination of funds in connection with a transaction involving Adxens Group. Such sharing will be limited to the information reasonably necessary for the stated purpose and will be conducted in accordance with applicable data protection law.
5.4 Business Transfers

In the event that Adxens Group is involved in a merger, acquisition, reorganisation, or sale of assets, your personal data may be transferred as part of that transaction. We will notify you of any such transfer and any changes to the applicable privacy policy.
5.5 With Your Consent
We may share your information with third parties where you have given your explicit consent to do so.
6. International Data Transfers

Adxens Group operates through entities in Hong Kong, the United States and Cameroun. Your personal data may be transferred to and processed in jurisdictions outside your country of residence, including jurisdictions that may not provide the same level of data protection as your home jurisdiction.

Where we transfer personal data from the European Economic Area (EEA) or the United Kingdom to a country that has not been deemed to provide an adequate level of data protection, we implement appropriate safeguards, which may include: Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission or the UK Information Commissioner’s Office, the recipient country’s adequacy determination, or other lawful transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection law.
By using our services, you acknowledge and consent to the transfer, processing, and storage of your personal data in accordance with this section.
7. Data Retention
We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, including:
Account data: retained for the duration of your account and for a reasonable period thereafter to allow for account reactivation or dispute resolution.
Transaction and payment records: retained for a minimum of six (6) years from the date of the transaction, as required by applicable financial record-keeping and anti-money laundering regulations.

Compliance and verification data (including KYB documents, sanctions screening results, and blockchain analytics records): retained for a minimum of six (6) years from the date of the relevant compliance activity or account closure, whichever is later.
Cryptocurrency wallet addresses and blockchain transaction data: retained for a minimum of six (6) years from the date of the last transaction, or such longer period as required by law.
Marketing and communication preferences: retained until you withdraw your consent or request deletion.

Where we are required by law, regulation, or court order to retain data for a longer period, we will do so in compliance with the applicable requirement. Once the applicable retention period expires, personal data will be securely deleted or anonymised.
8. Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include encryption of data in transit using SSL/TLS, secure cloud hosting infrastructure (AWS), access controls limiting data access to authorised personnel with a legitimate need to know, and regular review and updating of our security practices.

No method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your personal data, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.
9. Your Rights
Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have the following rights in respect of your personal data:
Right of access — to obtain confirmation of whether we process your personal data and to request a copy of it.
Right to rectification — to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data.
Right to erasure — to request deletion of your personal data, subject to our legal retention obligations.
Right to restriction — to request that we restrict the processing of your personal data in certain circumstances.
Right to data portability — to receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format.
Right to object — to object to the processing of your personal data where we rely on legitimate interests as the lawful basis.
Right to withdraw consent — where processing is based on consent, to withdraw that consent at any time.
Right to lodge a complaint — to lodge a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority in your jurisdiction.

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at customer-service@adxens.com. We will respond to your request within the timeframe required by applicable law (typically 30 days). We may request additional information to verify your identity before processing your request.

Please note that certain rights may be limited where we have a lawful basis to continue processing your data, including where retention is required for compliance with legal obligations (such as anti-money laundering record-keeping requirements). In such cases, we will inform you of the reason for any limitation.
10. Automated Decision-Making

Adxens Group uses automated tools, including blockchain analytics platforms and Know Your Transaction (KYT) solutions, to screen cryptocurrency transactions and wallet addresses for compliance and fraud prevention purposes. These tools generate risk scores based on algorithmic analysis of blockchain data, including the transaction history of wallet addresses, their proximity to flagged or sanctioned entities, and patterns consistent with illicit activity.

Automated screening may result in the rejection, delay, or flagging of a transaction, or the suspension or restriction of your account. Where an automated decision has a significant effect on you, you have the right to: (a) be informed that the decision was made using automated means; (b) receive a meaningful explanation of the logic involved; (c) request human review of the decision by contacting us at customer-service@adxens.com; and (d) contest the decision and provide additional information for consideration. Adxens Group will review such requests promptly and communicate the outcome to you.
11. Children’s Privacy

Our platform and services are not directed to individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 18. If you become aware that a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us and we will take steps to delete that information and terminate the associated account.
12. Third-Party Links and Services

The platform may contain links to third-party websites, services, or platforms (including advertising networks, social media platforms, and payment processors). Adxens Group is not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these third-party services. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party service you interact with.
13. Social Media
Our platform may include links and features connected to social media platforms. We recommend reviewing the privacy policies of each platform:
Meta (Facebook/Instagram/WhatsApp): https://www.facebook.com/privacy/explanation
Google: https://policies.google.com/privacy

14. Data Breach Notification

In the event of a personal data breach that is likely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of affected individuals, Adxens Group will notify the relevant supervisory authority without undue delay and, where feasible, within 72 hours of becoming aware of the breach, in accordance with applicable data protection law. Where the breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of affected individuals, Adxens Group will also notify the affected users without undue delay, providing information about the nature of the breach, the likely consequences, and the measures taken or proposed to address it. Adxens Group maintains internal procedures for detecting, investigating, reporting, and responding to data breaches.
15. Sub-Processors and Record of Processing

Adxens Group’s third-party service providers (as described in Section 5.1) may engage their own sub-processors to assist in the provision of their services. Adxens Group requires, through contractual data processing agreements, that all third-party processors and their sub-processors implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data and process it only in accordance with Adxens Group’s instructions and applicable data protection law. Adxens Group remains responsible for the acts and omissions of its processors in relation to your personal data.

Adxens Group maintains a record of its processing activities in accordance with Article 30 of the GDPR, which is available to relevant supervisory authorities upon request. This record includes the categories of personal data processed, the purposes of processing, the categories of recipients, international data transfers, and applicable retention periods.
16. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, legal requirements, or for other operational reasons. Where changes are material, we will notify you by posting a prominent notice on the platform or by sending you an email. The date at the top of this policy indicates when it was last updated. Your continued use of the platform after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.
17. Contact Information
If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or the processing of your personal data, please contact customer-service@adxens.com. Our Website is adxens-solutions.com

data.title: How to create an Adxens account
data.subtitle: Sign up, confirm your email and reach the dashboard in a few minutes.
data.search_tags: sign up register signup join new account email

children.text: Creating an account takes a few minutes. After that you can request ad accounts, fund them and invite your team.
Before you start
A work email address you can access.
The name of your agency or business.
During the private beta: a confirmed spot.
Step 1 – Sign up
Open Adxens and select Request Early Access (during the beta) or Sign up.
Enter your name, work email and a password.
Confirm your email address using the link we send you.
No email after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, then contact support.
Step 2 – Set up your workspace
Add your company details.
Choose the platforms you buy media on.
Select Finish setup.
Step 3 – Go to the dashboard
You land on the dashboard. From here, request your first ad account.

data.title: A quick tour of the dashboard
data.subtitle: Find accounts, funds, team and reports in one place.
data.search_tags: dashboard overview navigation menu home

children.text: The dashboard brings your ad accounts, funds, team and reports into one place.
Accounts: request, view and manage every ad account.
Funds: top up balances and follow every transaction.
Team: invite people and control what they can do.
Reports: see spend by account, campaign and period.

data.title: Which ad platforms are supported?
data.search_tags: meta google tiktok snapchat bing platforms facebook instagram

children.text: During the private beta, Adxens works with Meta only. Google, TikTok, Snapchat and Bing are on the platform roadmap and will be added after the beta.

data.title: Your first 10 minutes: a setup checklist
data.search_tags: checklist onboarding setup first steps start

children.text: Follow this short checklist to get fully set up:
Confirm your email and complete your company profile.
Request your first ad account.
Add funds to the account.
Invite one teammate and give them the Buyer role.
Open Reports to confirm spend appears.

data.title: How to request an ad account
data.subtitle: Request a new Meta ad account directly from the dashboard, with no ticket and no queue.
data.search_tags: request ad account new meta business manager create open

children.text: You can request ad accounts straight from the dashboard. Most requests are processed quickly.
Before you start
Your Adxens account is active.
You know the currency and time zone you need. They cannot be changed afterwards.
Step 1 – Open Accounts
Go to Accounts in the left menu.
Select Request account.
Step 2 – Fill in the details
Choose the platform (Meta during the beta).
Enter the account name, currency and time zone.
Add your Business Manager ID if you want the account shared.
Currency and time zone cannot be changed after the account is created. Double-check them before you submit.
Step 3 – Submit and track
Select Submit request.
Follow the request in Accounts → Requests. You will also get an email when it is ready.

data.title: Why is my ad account request still pending?
data.search_tags: pending status waiting delay slow review approval

children.text: Most requests are processed quickly, but a request can stay pending when we need extra information or when the platform is reviewing it.
Open the request in Accounts and check for a message asking for details.
Make sure the Business Manager ID you entered is correct.
If it is still pending after one business day, contact support with the request name.

data.title: Do I need a Meta Business Manager?
data.search_tags: meta business manager bm facebook portfolio

children.text: A Business Manager makes sharing and permissions simpler, because accounts can be attached to it directly.
If you do not have one yet, create it on Meta first, then add its ID to your Adxens profile.

data.title: Does Adxens guarantee ad approval?
data.search_tags: approval rejected disapproved ads policy review guarantee

children.text: No. Ad approval decisions are made by the advertising platform, and Adxens cannot guarantee them.
What we do give you is clearer visibility: you can see account status in one place and get help quickly if something is restricted.

data.title: How to add funds to an ad account
data.subtitle: Top up any ad account from the Funds page in a few clicks.
data.search_tags: add funds top up deposit fund balance recharge money

children.text: You can fund any of your ad accounts from the Funds page. The balance is available for ads as soon as the payment clears.
Step 1 – Choose the ad account
Open Funds from the left menu.
Select the ad account you want to fund.
Choose Add funds.
Step 2 – Enter the amount
Type the amount you want to add. The minimum is shown under the field.
Pick a saved payment method or add a new one.
Step 3 – Confirm and track
Check the summary and select Confirm payment.
Follow the status in Funds → Transactions.

data.title: How much is the minimum deposit?
data.search_tags: minimum deposit amount limit top up how much least

children.text: The minimum top-up depends on your plan and the payment method you choose. You can see it on the Add funds screen before you confirm, and nothing is charged until you approve.
If you are unsure which amount suits your budget, start small. You can top up again at any time.

data.title: Which payment methods can I use?
data.search_tags: payment methods card bank transfer pay local mobile money crypto

children.text: Available methods depend on your country and the platform. The payment screen only shows the methods you can use.
You can save a method for next time and remove it from Funds → Payment methods whenever you like.

data.title: Do I need to deposit real money during the beta?
data.search_tags: beta real money deposit test spend cost fund

children.text: Testing happens on the real platform, with a real plan and real pricing, exactly like a regular client. That means ad spend is real.
Fund only the amount you are comfortable running during the test.

data.subtitle: Add people to your workspace and decide exactly what they can do.
data.search_tags: invite teammate team member add user colleague share access

children.text: Invite colleagues, freelancers or clients and give each of them only the access they need.
Step 1 – Send the invitation
Open Team and select Invite member.
Enter their email address.
Choose a role: Admin, Buyer or Viewer.
Step 2 – Choose what they can see
Select the ad accounts the person can access.
Select Send invite.
Step 3 – Wait for them to accept
The invite shows as Pending in the Team list. They join as soon as they accept.

data.title: Roles and permissions explained
data.search_tags: roles permissions owner admin buyer viewer access control

children.text: Every member has a role. Choose the lowest level that lets them do their job.
Owner: full control, including billing and deleting the workspace.
Admin: manage accounts, funds and members.
Buyer: use assigned accounts and view their spend.
Viewer: read-only access to reports.

data.title: How to remove someone's access
data.search_tags: remove revoke access delete member leave offboard

children.text: Open Team, select the member, then choose Remove access. Their access to every account ends immediately.
Their past activity stays in the audit log so your reports remain accurate.

data.title: How to track spend across accounts
data.search_tags: track spend dollar budget report overview accounts every dollar

children.text: The Reports page shows spend for every account in one view.
Select a date range.
Group by account, platform or team member.
Select any row to drill into campaigns.

data.title: How to export a report
data.search_tags: export report csv pdf download share

children.text: Open any report and choose Export. You can download it as CSV or PDF, or copy a share link for teammates who have access.

data.title: Set spend alerts and limits
data.search_tags: alert limit notification threshold budget cap overspend

children.text: Alerts notify you when an account approaches a threshold you set.
Open the account and select Alerts.
Enter a daily or total threshold.
Choose email, in-app notifications or both.

data.title: Where do I find my invoices?
data.search_tags: invoice receipt billing history statement download tax

children.text: Go to Billing → Invoices. Every payment has its own invoice that you can download as PDF. Add your company and tax details under Billing → Details to have them printed on future invoices.

data.title: How to change or cancel my plan
data.search_tags: plan change cancel subscription upgrade downgrade pricing

children.text: Open Billing → Plan, choose the plan you want and confirm.
Changes apply from the next billing period. If you cancel, you keep access until the end of the period you already paid for.

data.title: How do refunds work?
data.search_tags: refund money back unused balance return withdraw

children.text: Eligibility depends on the platform and the payment method used. Unused balance can usually be requested back from the Funds page.
If you cannot find the option for your account, contact support and include the transaction reference.

data.title: Is the Beta still available?
data.search_tags: beta available open spots apply waitlist private still closed

children.text: Adxens V2 is in private beta with a limited number of spots (35 media buyers). Check the banner on the beta page for the current status.
If applications are closed when you read this, contact support and we will let you know when the next group opens.

data.title: How are testers selected?
data.search_tags: selected selection testers chosen apply criteria operators

children.text: We look for active media buyers and agency operators who run real Meta ad spend and can share honest feedback. Applying is free, and selected testers are contacted by email.

data.title: How much time will testing take?
data.search_tags: time weeks duration commitment how long beta three weeks

children.text: Testing runs for three weeks. There is no fixed schedule: use Adxens in your normal workflow and tell us what works and what does not.

data.title: How to send feedback or report a bug
data.search_tags: feedback bug report issue problem vote suggest feature

children.text: Use the Feedback button in the dashboard, or message support with a short description and a screenshot if you can. Testers also get a direct line to the team and a real vote on what we build next.

data.title: What exactly is the free month?
data.search_tags: free month first month trial discount pricing beta perk

children.text: Selected testers get their first month on us. After that you stay on the plan you chose, with normal pricing, unless you cancel before the month ends.

data.title: How to reset your password
data.search_tags: reset password forgot login sign in recover access locked

children.text: On the sign-in page select Forgot password.
Enter your email and open the link we send you.
Choose a new password. All other sessions are signed out.
No email after a few minutes? Check spam, then contact support.

data.title: Turn on two-factor authentication
data.search_tags: 2fa two factor authentication security authenticator code protect

children.text: Two-factor authentication adds a one-time code to your sign-in, which protects the funds in your ad accounts.
Open Profile → Security.
Select Enable 2FA and scan the QR code with an authenticator app.
Enter the 6-digit code and save your backup codes.

data.title: Update your name, email or company details
data.search_tags: profile update change email name company details account settings

children.text: Open Profile to edit your name, company details and notification settings. Changing your email requires confirming the new address first.

data.title: How to delete your account
data.search_tags: delete close remove account data privacy gdpr

children.text: Only the workspace Owner can delete an account. Withdraw or spend any remaining balance first, then go to Profile → Security → Delete account.
Deletion is permanent. Invoices are kept for the period required by law.
